title: Why the finite H-Tilt survivor law survived
reason: The survivor-law claim reduces to finite algebra: after the Doob transform, multiplying by the unnormalized biorthogonal weight q_i h_i cancels h_i and leaves the left-eigenvector residual q^T(K-lambda I), which is zero by assumption.
core_calculation: = sum_i q_i h_i ((K_ij - lambda delta_ij) h_j / h_i)
boundary: Lean algebraic finite-state theorem under explicit eigenvector and nonzero assumptions
